Creator: William Morgan (translator), for the Welsh church
Publisher: England: by the deputies of Christopher Barker, Printer to the Queen's most excellent Majesty (the host record), 1588
Publication Date: 1588 (host date)
Rights: Public Domain (pd-us-by-date: published 1588); the archive.org record carries no rights field, so the imprint date is the basis
Language: cym
Source: archive.org item bim_early-english-books-1475-1640_y-beibl-cyssegr-lan-sef_bible-welsh_1588, full text from the item's own djvu.txt. Fetched directly 2026-11-10 by the Library thread; the byte count of the downloaded file (5,323,785) equals the size archive.org lists for the djvu.txt.
Provenance note: Extracted unaltered: the item's own djvu.txt is reproduced whole after this header; nothing was stripped, normalized or corrected. Rights basis: published 1588, out of US copyright by date. SCAN QUALITY: second witness only; quote only after checking the passage against the scanned page. Poor OCR: long s, letter substitutions and lost Welsh diacritics throughout; the Latin dedication reads better than the Welsh. Line numbers cited in this header are lines of the host OCR; add 12 for this file's own line numbers.
Content note: The first complete Welsh Bible. William Morgan's Latin dedicatory epistle to Elizabeth I ('EPISTOLA DEDICATORIA', about OCR lines 386-540, signed 'GVLIELMVS MORGANVS' at about 535) on putting both Testaments and the Prayer Book into Welsh; the Welsh text of the Bible follows.
